Overview.Name: Ruka Mamatha
Overview.Goal: Improve appearance, energy, and manage PCOS with steady fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables (no brinjal)
Option 2: Curd bowl + cooked vegetable side (no brinjal)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables (no brinjal)
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables (no brinjal)
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable curry + small portion plain rice + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Keep fried and very spicy foods occasional.
Eat meals on time to support PCOS and hormonal balance.
Include protein (paneer or dal) in every main meal.
Yoga and daily routine support fat loss and mood.
Focus on consistency and body feel rather than quick scale changes.
